create_container: create a new LLM container via POST /v1/containers with name and expiration settings
list_containers: list all LLM containers via GET /v1/containers with optional limit and order query params
retrieve_container: retrieve details of a specific LLM container via GET /v1/containers/{container_id}
delete_container: delete a specific LLM container via DELETE /v1/containers/{container_id}
register_container_file_endpoints: register JSON-configured container file endpoints on a FastAPI router
